question: What would turn the existential Hadwiger claim into an independently replayable finite test?

nodes.title: The upstream statement is an existential graph construction
nodes.detail: The audited comparator gives existence claims involving chromatic and Hadwiger-number bounds, not a listed finite adjacency matrix.

nodes.title: No explicit finite graph accompanies the construction
nodes.detail: A second Lean kernel replay does not supply the graph that this repository's finite graph checker would need. The evidence state remains claim under review.

nodes.title: Extract a graph or obtain independent specialist reviews
nodes.detail: For the finite-witness path, supply a finite graph and independently check a coloring lower bound and clique-minor upper bound. Specialist review of the existential proof is a different acceptance path.
